bookLayout.title: Book Layout Design for Print and Digital
bookLayout.description: <up>Every well written book</up> deserves a layout that enhances the reading experience. I specialize in designing layouts for both print and digital formats, ensuring that your content is presented in the most engaging and readable way possible. Whether you're publishing a novel, a non-fiction book, or a photo book, I can create a layout that reflects your vision and meets the technical requirements of your chosen publishing platform.

items.question: What formats do you deliver?
items.answer: I deliver print-ready PDFs and EPUBs for digital distribution. If you only need one format, we'll decide together based on your platform and needs.

items.question: Do you work with KDP?
items.answer: Yes, I set up layouts following Amazon KDP's technical specs — margins, bleed, image resolution, and file format are all configured to upload without issues.

items.question: What do I need to get started?
items.answer: Your manuscript in Word or a similar format, any images or illustrations in high resolution, and a rough idea of the style you have in mind. I'll take care of the rest.

items.question: Do you work with illustrated books or books with images?
items.answer: Yes, I handle layouts with text, images, and illustrations — novels, non-fiction, photography books, manuals.

items.question: Can I choose the fonts?
items.answer: Yes. If you already have something in mind I'll help you evaluate it; if you're starting from scratch I'll suggest the best options for your book's genre and audience.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Turnaround depends on the length and complexity of the book. We'll agree on a timeline before starting, so you have a clear delivery date from the beginning.

items.question: How many revisions are included?
items.answer: Two revisions are included in the price, allowing you to request adjustments after reviewing the layout at no extra cost.

items.question: Do you work with international clients?
items.answer: Yes, I work with both Italian and international clients. I communicate fluently in Italian and English.

steps.title: Get in touch
steps.description: Reach out by email or through the contact form. Tell me about your project — genre, length, publishing platform, and timeline. I'll get back to you within 24 hours with a tailored quote.

steps.title: Briefing and kickoff
steps.description: For more complex projects, we'll align on style, fonts, and visual references. Once we're on the same page, I will start working.

steps.title: Draft and revisions
steps.description: You'll receive a complete first draft of the layout. Two rounds of revisions are included — nothing is considered final until you're happy with the result.

steps.title: Final delivery
steps.description: Once the draft is approved, you receive the final files — print-ready PDF and/or EPUB, ready to upload to KDP.
